concerns.text: Functional Requirement FR-011 (pipeline must complete within ≤ 6 hours) and Success Criterion SC-006 are not covered by any task. No task measures or asserts the total end‑to‑end runtime, leaving the requirement unverified.
Artifact name `data/cleaned_alloys.csv` used in later phases differs from the spec’s reference to `data.csv`; this naming mismatch may cause traceability confusion.
